newsitem.title: USA: US late spot propane narrowly mixed in scant trade.
newsitem.headline: US late spot propane narrowly mixed in scant trade.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were narrowly mixed late Friday, players said, with very little activity ahead of next week's Christmas holiday.

Spot propane in the Midwest trading hub of Conway, Kansas, was talked between 95.0 and 96.0 cents a gallon, about two cents less than Thursday, players said, while any-month material was sold for 95 cents in the morning.
Conway traders said expected more cold weather next week was likely to keep a firm floor under the strong prices.
Prices gained two cents in the Gulf Coast, meanwhile, where Mont Belvieu propane was talked at 63.75 cents although few deals were seen.
